notes.title: 1.0.15 is OUT
notes.content:
Hi Folks

Pretty big update hits our main branch today:

- Includes a new introduction stage where you assume an avatar of our anti-hero, Tithonus.  Also includes new backstory.

- There are new artifacts down in the catacombs.  Keep an eye out for them - they're a little bit hidden.

- This build supports Oculus - but it also *requires* Touch controllers.

- We've fixed a bug that was causing poor frame rates upon entering the catacombs.

- We've restored some blink points that were missing above ground.

Let us know what you think!

notes.title: 1.0.15 is out in BETA
notes.content:
Hi Folks

A couple minor fixes and additions for this update:
- Some broken scenery above ground was fixed
- A potential conflict in the starting zone where the player was coincident on start with the avatar was fixed
- Better dynamics on the intro scroll

We'll push this over to the main branch in a couple days, barring any nasty bug reports.

notes.title: 1.0.14 is in BETA
notes.content:
Hi Folks

After a long delay, we've posted a pretty big update to Abbot's Book.  Several fixes and additions:

- This should fix frame rates upon entering the catacombs.

- Includes a new introduction stage, where you assume an avatar of our anti-hero, Tithonus.  Also includes back story.

- This build supports Oculus, but it also *requires* Touch controllers.

- We've put some new artifacts down in the catacombs.  Keep an eye out for them - they're a little bit hidden.

- We've restored some choices in areas to explore above ground.

We'll keep this in beta for a bit, then release to the main branch.  Please let us know if you have any difficulties.
